text: Election of the Vice Chair of the Budget Committee under Municipal Code Chapter 27, Council Procedures, Appendix A-2, for a term of office ending December 31, 2020, and until a successor is appointed.

The Budget Committee: 1. Elected Councillor Brad Bradford as Vice Chair of the Budget Committee for a term of office starting January 28, 2019 and ending December 31, 2020, and until a successor is appointed.
